$comment: Canonical client contract. Automatic placement is explicit target, primary, secondary, then remoteless. Mobile may explicitly select phone-local execution, but it is never the default and does not replace primary/secondary assignments. Unsupported work is blocked with a named code and route; it is never reported as completed.

web.note: Hosted DeepSeek may execute remotely, but the browser itself must never be described as a shell/build host.

watchos-wearos-car.note: Initiate, observe, approve, and narrate. The phone/device/cloud target executes and returns the same structured capability verdict.

tvos-androidtv.note: Rendering means displaying a stream or existing served artifact; these clients do not run Flutter or a dev server locally.

cli-agent.note: Configured device runners retain order; the DeepSeek remoteless runner is appended last when usable.
